modifications.main_source: Logging and flushing only; verified normalizing logging reproduces original Main.lean.

sandbox: Native fake-landrun.sh shim; no Linux sandbox isolation
build_context: Existing compiled dependencies reused; not a clean-room rebuild
command_template: CSD_GUARD_PROCESS_METRICS=1 COMPARATOR_LANDRUN="$CSD_COMPARATOR/scripts/fake-landrun.sh" COMPARATOR_LEAN4EXPORT="$CSD_COMPARATOR/.lake/packages/lean4export/.lake/build/bin/lean4export" python3 verification/serial_guard.py "$CSD_COMPARATOR_LOG" caffeinate -i lake env "$CSD_COMPARATOR/.lake/build/bin/comparator" AllCharacteristics/ComparatorChallenge/config.json
command_note: Run from the project root; CSD_COMPARATOR in the recorded run pointed to the separately built, instrumented Comparator copy.

log.normalization: None: decompression yields the original Comparator stdout/stderr log, including local paths.

excerpt.selection: Original build summary, STAGE, kernel, and final verdict lines; no synthetic lines.

guard_terminal_result_source: Observed guard terminal output; guard heartbeats and exit summary are separate from the Comparator stdout/stderr log.
shutdown_evidence: Successful full ps inventory: no PID/PPID/PGID 62823 and no Comparator, lean4export, Lean or Lake processes. Exact log unheld (lsof exit 1); global compiler lock acquired and released; no unconfirmed marker.
scope: Main CSD Comparator challenge only. Other paper challenge configurations were not run in this attempt.
interpretation: Recorded native statement/axiom comparison and Lean kernel replay of the main CSD solution. No Nanoda verdict, Linux sandbox claim, or Comparator verdict for every selected manuscript conclusion.
